blocks.text: No evidence yet for **Hint response**. Q3 covers it: Design a rate limiter for a public API…

msgs.what: Runs when an analysis is recorded, before `plan_actions` fans out. Pure bookkeeping; no model call.

For a quality-3 answer on a coding question with code in the editor: `problem_solving`, `communication` (dimensions present) and `code_quality` (coding + code). `hint_responsiveness` needs a hint-reception dimension; `behavioral` needs signals or flags or a behavioral question; `system_design` that category. A failed analysis (quality 0) adds nothing.
`resume_verification` is topped up with claimed-experience facts and contradictions found so far. Status: 0 none, 1 to 2 thin, 3 or more solid.

The strip colours a chip per criterion. For the first gap it looks through the plan's later questions for one whose category feeds that criterion and names it. `hint_responsiveness` has no category, so in practice the next named gap is usually system design or behavioral.

One draft note per analysed answer with a 200-character quote, plus a red-flags note when the analysis raised any. Notes are keyed `u-41:note` and `u-41:flags`; a re-run never duplicates them. The list is capped at 60 in state.
